'''Kelen''' was a fair-skinned, [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the rank of [[Private/Legends|private]] in the military of the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, they served House Organa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they were stationed in the market section of House Organa's [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] region. At the market, they worked selling a range of weapons from a table to other Republic individuals, where they carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that included a helmet.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Kelen first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Kelen was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Their position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
